title: Weird Town Dreams
content: I found this looking for reasons why I am having these dreams. I have always had very vivid dreams but for about a year I have been having what I call "town dreams". I honestly feel like I am going crazy lol. I keep trying to tell my partner and friends about them but they just look at me weird. I feel so exhausted when I wake up. I just want to tell someone else that might understand. Every single night I go to this town(s)? Its familiar at times- there are definitely places I go back to. But there are new places as well. The place isn't scary but its also not fun, it feels unsettling. There is a part of the town I could map and I suppose where I live in the town. Reoccurring places: * School- dont go there all the time but I have been before. I was enrolled at the school at one time but I havent been going there for awhile lol * Trails- there are trails that go by river/lake, there are houses sometimes and sometimes there is nothing but the trails are dirt or rock * Train- Havent spent a lot of time on train * Bridge that goes to mountains- I have been to the mountains only a few times and was visiting. there is a school there haha * Airport * Always feels like I will miss my flight but never do- airport is weird. Dont ever remember actually flying but I will be in other places shortly after arriving at airport * Waterpark- water park has a long ladder going up to a slide- slide feels like you will die but dont if you go on it * Bonus water park indoors? I have been a few times * Forest with some houses- river/lake faces the backside of the homes * I have stayed here before but I dont live here * Abandoned Apartment building but people live there? I keep looking at apartments there but they dont lock well and I ask if the guy has left yet? * Guy that lived in the apartment behind me for a bit in this building where I presume I was renting a space- he could get into the apartment bc the locks were broken * Shopping center * There is a strip mall? * There is also a larger shopping center that feels maybe like a market square but when you go inside there are different rooms for different stores reminds me of pike place market in seattle but its not on the water. Nothing terrible has happened that I can remember but i always feel uneasy like I am waiting for something bad to happen. I never feel rested waking up anymore. I feel when I wake up I am mapping where I have been. I know I am in the town when I am there- I am like oh great back in my town here we go haha. Then I go about my town motions until I wake up 🤷🏻‍♀️
